Title: Sapphire Cascade Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
Three separate pours of deep sapphire-blue resin, each draped over and around the last, rise into a crown of curling petals and tall flame-like fingers. The blue deepens at every edge and fades to a frosty white at the base, so light seems to pour down through it.

Each layer has to be draped at exactly the right moment. Too early and the resin slides straight off; too late and it won't move at all. So all three pours were watched closely and shaped by hand, one after another. At 600 g it's a substantial, weighty piece.

This is a decorative piece. The upper edges and fingers are thin, so handle it gently.
